headline: The commission awarded the lowest bid of $17,900 to LNR Tractor for demolition and cleanup of 318 School Ave.
The commission selected the lowest bid, from George Outlaw Construction at $22,500, for the Fitness Court concrete slab.
The Commission amended the grant services contract with The Integrity Group to raise the not-to-exceed limit to $2,500,000.
The Commission approved $20,369.42 in additional costs for the 7th and 8th Street stormwater projects.
The commission approved the Integrity Group for CDBG-CV grant management consultant services for the Civic Center Project.
The commission approved a $15,950 service agreement with Tullo Planning Group for landscape design and permitting of the city's gateway signage.
The commission approved Mott MacDonald to do a city-wide water and sewer capacity study for no more than $15,000.
The commission approved Rumberger Kirk to provide employment law services.
The commission authorized the mayor and city attorney to revise the Ashbritt and Tetra Tech debris removal contracts for consideration of extensions.
The commission approved the agreement for code enforcement magistrate services with Attorney Albert J. Stopka III.
The commission authorized the mayor to sign and accept Royal American's bid for the water and sewer rehabilitation project upon FDEP approval.
The commission awarded the disaster recovery administrative services contract to the Integrity Group.
The commission authorized trading in the Public Works Director's truck toward a new truck.
The commission awarded the disaster debris monitoring services RFP to Tetra Tech.
The commission awarded the disaster debris removal, reduction and hauling services RFP to Ashbritt.
The commission voted to award the HMGP Sanitary Sewer Bypass Pumps bid to Marshall Brothers Construction for $609,300.
The commission awarded RFP 2024-01 Professional Planning Services to Design West Group per the Evaluation Committee's recommendation.
The commission voted to trade in Truck #2402 toward purchase of a new 2024 Dodge Ram 1500 for $32,499.50.
The commission approved paying $19,245 to Bay County Transit for services to the City.
The commission accepted the lowest bid, $18,500 from Smiley's Lawn and Tractor Service, for demolition and cleanup of 3901 E. 8th St.
The commission approved a service agreement with HST Utility Contractors for the lead line survey required by FDEP.
The commission approved Task Order #4 with STOA Architects for improvements to Springfield Gardens Walking Park.
The commission awarded the 2nd Street Sidewalk Project to Preslie Construction, the lowest bidder.
The commission awarded the CDBG-HRP Streetscape Project engineering and design to Gortemoller Engineering.
The Commission approved a one-year extension of the continuing services contract with STOA Architects.
The commission approved renewing the Motorola body camera contract for $79,380.
The commission approved TextCare as additional employee health coverage.
